# Replication Package of Managing Socio-Technical Debt in the Industry with the STeDy Framework

[REDACTED]

This is the replication package of the study *Managing Socio-Technical Debt in the Industry with the STeDy Framework*. It contains the debt management system created after applying the STeDy framework, as well as the resulting debt registry and evaluation of the different debt stories.

The debt registry is available in the following folders:

- [`Debt Register/Debt Register.xlsx`](/Debt%20Register/Debt%20Register.xlsx) contains the debt register with the debt stories and their data defined after applying the STeDy framework.
- [`Evaluation Reports of Debt Occurrences/`](/Evaluation%20Reports%20of%20Debt%20Occurrences/) contains the individual evaluations of the different debt stories that are in the registry, build following the template available in [`Evaluation Report Template/`](/Evaluation%20Report%20Template/).

The data and analysis collected during the evaluation are available in the following folders:

- [`Data Analysis/`](/Data%20Analysis/) contains the R files to perform the automated analysis of the Debt Registry and generate the graphics of the paper.
- [`Surveys/`](/Surveys/) contains the questionnaire, data, and analysis for the post intervention survey (in [`Surveys/1 - Original Survey/`](/Surveys/1%20-%20Original%20Survey/)), and the follow-up survey (in [`Surveys/2 - Follow-Up Survey/`](/Surveys/2%20-%20Follow-Up%20Survey/)).
- [`Severity Assessment Rules for Debt Occurrences/Severity Assessment Rules for Debt Occurrences.xlsx`](/Severity%20Assessment%20Rules%20for%20Debt%20Occurrences/Severity%20Assessment%20Rules%20for%20Debt%20Occurrences.xlsx) contains the result of the workshops for defining the security score and formula. A template to help defining those in other applications of STeDy is available in [`Severity Assessment Rules for Debt Occurrences Template/Severity Assessment Rules for Debt Occurrences Template.xlsx`](/Severity%20Assessment%20Rules%20for%20Debt%20Occurrences%20Template/Severity%20Assessment%20Rules%20for%20Debt%20Occurrences%20Template.xlsx).
